{{Attr|Aggro}} (''Feral Rush'') |ability1='''{{WikiAb|Feral Rush}}''' - Upon reaching 40% health, the '''Yeti''' increases speed to 16 and gains [[Aggro]]. }} ==Description== The '''Yeti''' is a fast enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It has middling health and a fast speed. While initially already fast, it has an ability where upon reaching 40% of its health, it will increase its speed to 16 and gains the [[Aggro]] attribute. ==Appearance== The '''Yeti''' has blue skin with white fur. It has two neon blue eyes and two blue horns. ==Strategy== *Decent DPS or high range towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Operator]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]] and [[Medic]] can be used to boost these towers. *Slowing towers, such as the [[Warden]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Archer]], can be used to slow the '''Yeti''' down, as it is quite fast and has no immunities. **It is however quite big, so certain forms of stalling like knockback or freeze will be slightly less effective against it. **The [[Commando]]'s ''Missile'' ability can be used to lay down multiple missiles on the path that will stun the '''Yeti'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseYeti.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FrostModeThumbnail.png|'''Yeti''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} WinterEvent2025PromoImage.png|'''Yeti''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Yeti''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Yeti''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *In Himalayan folklore, the [[wp:Yeti|Yeti]] is a large ape-like creature inhabiting the Himalayan mountain range. *The '''Yeti''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''3 December 2025''' -
